claim_assertions.bitstamp_majority_q4: Bitstamp represents more than half of Q4FY2025 combined crypto notional volume.
claim_assertions.removing_settlement_benefit_reduces_expe: Removing the Q4FY2024 settlement benefit lowers adjusted operating expense.
claim_assertions.organic_asset_gain_identified: The supplied observations identify the exact FY2025 organic investment return within Total Platform Assets.

definitions.expense_audit: Adjusted expense subtracts signed SBC, settlements and credit losses. Including SBC adds it back to adjusted expense. Settlement removal is minus the signed settlement expense.
definitions.annual_revenue_bridge: Use reported annual component changes divided by reported total revenue change.
definitions.crypto_scope: Two output scopes, app and bitstamp, for Q4FY2025 and January2026. Share uses the combined total for that same period. Monthly average divides by disclosed duration and is not a seasonally adjusted forecast.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
